5. Public screenings and festivals:  
  • Some events or festivals offer free screenings of movies, sometimes including works that are not readily available on mainstream platforms. These events are scheduled and organized with proper licensing, and they provide an opportunity to see films legally.  

The key in all these suggestions is that the content has been distributed under arrangements that secure the rights to view it without the viewer having to pay directly (or at least without bypassing the channels set up by the copyright owners).
